notes.title: Entity Researchers XP Analysis
notes.notes:
Here's a closer look at some [b]Entity Researchers XP[/b] data and [b]Mission[/b] requirements.

The Experience curve for leveling has changed considerably over time, [b]Levels 1-30[/b] remain the same but the later game became a grind. As you can see below [b]XP[/b] required from level 30 onward is reduced significantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928294/cb1a8f99637b4634f0530171a54ba6f9fc180c61.png[/img]
[i]Experience curves for Level 1-50[/i]


[b]Entity XP[/b] yield has increased by around [b]10%,[/b] though as you level up the [b]XP[/b] will reduce accordingly, [b]Casefile[/b] and [b]Elite[/b] entities drop a little extra [b]XP[/b] increasing by around [b]15%[/b].

As many entities will be capped to their maximum level, [b]XP[/b] gain slows in the later levels further compounding the grind in the previous [b]XP[/b] curve.
This could be somewhat mitigated with [b]+XP Up Unique[/b]  items though this modifier is quite rare for dropped [b]Uniques[/b] leaving this option dictated too much by chance.

As [b]Missions[/b] are compulsory to the completion of the main Entity Researchers narrative more players should now reach the final group of [b]Missions[/b].
Below you will find a list of [b]Missions[/b] and individual Level requirements:

Lvl
10  -  01: [b]Entities Aquatic[/b]
16  -  02: [b]Masks Off[/b]
22  -  03: [b]Burning Belief[/b]
28  -  04: [b]Overload[/b]
35  -  05: [b]Illumination[/b]
42  -  06: [b]Body Snatchers[/b]
48  -  07: [b]Last Known Location[/b]
52  -  08: [b]The Sunken Ward[/b]
55  -  09: [b]Dark Times[/b]
[i](Complete Dark Times)[/i] 10: [b]The Grand Opening[/b]

Drop a comment if you would like to see anything else covered in further posts.

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.18
notes.notes:
Thanks everybody for playing Entity Researchers, the game has been in Early Access for nearly six months now and lots of things have been fixed and added in that time.
It's been a tough time working solo but I think the game is at the point to move from Early Access.
As updating everything and such requires plenty of effort I will probably only be fixing bugs from this point forward as I prepare everything else, I suppose this means Entity Researchers is now feature complete.
I'm aiming to move from Early Access in February if all goes to plan; once again thanks to everybody that's made Entity Researchers better.

There's new Entity sprites in the game for the ten Rare entities and as I move through the files and replace duplicates with new sprites the game will finally be complete, this was the biggest behind-the-scenes job that really needed to be finished and it's moving closer to completion.
There's four new achievements for defeating Contract Casefiles, from 1 to 20 contracts. The drop-rate for Contracts has also been increased from Casefile entities.

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.17
notes.notes:
With the new [b]Generator[/b] item a 100 level endurance map with a Case entity every 10 levels will be created. Generator encounters will use totally random entities disregarding location and time, providing plenty of XP and Res but no items, entities not in your Database will appear but be rendered unscannable.
All entities will level-scale as high as permitted to the player level including Casefiles so the Generator will definitely be punishing. The Generator is unlocked at the end of the main story Missions.
There are four new Steam Achievements for beating Generator levels 10, 40, 70 and 100.

You may encounter two new rarer NPCs while exploring, Dr. Moss is active during the day and Rolk at night. The NPC rate has been increased so all random NPCs now appear more frequently.
Find [b]Doctor Moss[/b] out in the field researching during the daylight hours, for entity information from your Database she'll reward you with Res.
At night the telepath [b]Rolk[/b] could appear, gifting Stat Points every time he chooses to arrive.

The Player career Objective line has been extended with extra late-game objectives to prevent looping too early.

[b]Notes:[/b]
Generator item
NPC Dr. Moss

Increased NPC rate
Player Objectives extended

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.16
notes.notes:
Plenty of minor changes mechanically to tighten up elements of the game.
Move Aim targeting has been cleaned up to more accurately display a Hit/Miss, hopefully no more fury over a Hit on the edge that looked like it landed.
Aim target growth using +Criticals items has also increased for more immediate effect.

Rare entities have also had an overhaul to coincide with the new [b]Hunter[/b] Steam Achievement; research any of these ten unclassified entities to unlock. Rare entities now have blue names and a new field animation, their EIRINet Database entries have also been altered. The Rare entity rate has also been slightly reduced to 1/400, so still quite elusive!

The basic entity HP curve has been smoothed for less growth spikes at certain Player level thresholds.
An issue when replacing ERX-Mod pieces is also now fixed.
The Luck stat threshold for Rare+ Uniques has also been reduced, so occasionally a nice Rare+ could drop earlier in the game.

[b]Notes:[/b]
More accurate Aim
+Criticals Aim increase
Rare Entity alterations
Decreased basic entity HP curve
Lower Luck/Unique threshold
ERX-Mod Item glitch

Things have changed since Version 4 including plenty of bug fixes and general balancing.

Notes:
New Critical bonus round.
Stat Points notification fixed.
Item bug fixed.
Sell menu fixed.
Reduced Market prices.
Damage balancing.
Less entities per map.
No extra-large maps.
Job level caps entity level.
All Missions working.

Hopefully if running smoothly I'll be moving on to a few side-quest NPCs/merchants in the maps and working on the Missions which need attention, non-story Missions are removed for now but eventually they will have new objectives to differ from normal Jobs. 
I've played through all the story Missions and they now all work correctly.
I'll also be adding more Critical bonus types and extra bonuses for higher level moves.
Thanks for helping hunt down all the problems this far.
I think the game feels pretty solid right now... 
Got some awesome ideas for new stuff and the game's only going to keep getting better.

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.4
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing!

Notes:
Smoother movement.
Flee bug fix.
Reduced battle transition flash.
Optional tutorial.
Balanced Move XP curve.
Balanced Affinity damage reduction.
Refine bug.
Affinity/Aversion shown.
Other minor fixes.

The next update may take a while but I will be expanding the Aim/Attack system to include an extra Aim phase with extra rhythm sections. so it'll be a big one.

notes.title: Entity Researchers Version 0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Plenty of things fixed in this new build, thank you all for your feedback.
Still plenty of things to do but some of these broke the game.

Notes:
Electric Research Rate fixed.
Shift/click to move Items to and from the Loadout.
Cutscene bugs.
Less entities per level.
More XP per slain entity.
Entities move more in the Viewport.
Possibly fixed Cultist mission bugs.
Speed stat now affects turn time, attack aim speed and scan target speed.
Move glitch now removed, this corrupted save files and lots of things were affected. If you have items/moves in your current save that has a glitched name or info consisting of numbers you will need to start a new game unfortunately.
